title: The effect of active galactic nuclei on the cold interstellar medium in distant star-forming galaxies
question: What is the effect of mid-IR- and X-ray-detected AGN on the molecular gas reservoirs, excitation (CO, [CI] SLEDs) and dust of IR-selected main-sequence and starburst galaxies at z~1-1.7?

evidence.quote: The modeling of the SED was performed on the de-blended far-IR catalog by (cite: jin_2018)
2-10 keV rest frame logarithmic luminosity (column #50 in (cite: marchesi_2016); negative values: upper limits)

what.value: ASPECS and Liu+21 CO compilations used for comparison and fit

evidence.loc: 3.2 The effect on CO line luminosities
evidence.quote: we also added the literature compilation from (cite: liu_2021) who applied an SED modeling similar to and consistent with ours

recipe.goal: SED fit for L_IR, f_AGN, Mdust, U
recipe.method: chi2 minimization with Draine & Li templates plus Mullaney AGN templates on far-IR catalog plus ALMA continuum
key_parameters: 4/55 extreme-f_AGN cases refit with U fixed to redshift average, 30% variation

recipe.method: Kaplan-Meier mean including robust upper limits, split by f_AGN=20% and X-ray detection
tau = kappa850 (nu/nu850)^beta Mdust/(2 pi R^2) with ALMA sizes; kendall tau and KS tests

recipe.goal: Fit L'CO(5-4) as linear combination of L_IR,SFR and L_IR,AGN
recipe.method: Bayesian multiple linear regression with upper limits, zero intercept
